title: Planning Advisory Committee - February 22, 2024
meeting_location: Colonel By Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting remotely with the following link:
Zoom Webinar ID : 874 9309 6554
Those who require a telephone number to call into the Zoom meeting may contact the committee coordinator.
This meeting will be live streamed and archived to the Ottawa City Council YouTube channel. This meeting’s recording will also be uploaded to the City’s agendas and minutes web portal (eScribe) after the meeting. 
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Election of Chair and Vice-chair
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Committee considered item 5.1, then returned to this item.
Caitlin Salter MacDonald, Manager of Council and Committee Services, provided an overview of the election process.
Following nominations for the position of Chair, the sole nominee, Carolyn Mackenzie, was acclaimed to the position of Chair for a term of one year.
Following nominations for the position of Vice-Chair, the sole nominee, Zachary Hunter, was acclaimed to the position of Vice-Chair for a term of one year.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the Planning Advisory Committee elect a Chair and Vice-Chair.

agenda_items.title: Other Business
agenda_items.minutes:
Member C. White requested that the Committee consider discussing Zoning By-law enforcement at a later meeting.
Caitlin Salter MacDonald, Manager of Council and Committee Services, responded that where Members wish to consider additional items, they could communicate this to the Chair, who would work with the committee coordinator to consider with staff whether such a matter could be incorporated into upcoming agenda items.
